sources.entry: Numi - Beautiful calculator app for macOS

summary.one_liner: Numi is a natural-language calculator app for macOS, with a terminal version (numi-cli) and an Alfred extension.
summary.what_it_does: Numi lets you type calculations written close to plain language, such as "$20 in euro - 5% discount" or "today + 2 weeks", and returns the result instantly. The desktop app for macOS can be downloaded from the project website or the GitHub releases page, and the README also lists a Windows version. A terminal version, numi-cli, runs a single expression passed as an argument, for example numi-cli "20 inches in cm". It can be installed with a shell command or through Homebrew. An Alfred extension is also available and requires the terminal version to work. The README lists several desktop features as not yet implemented in the terminal version, including timezone conversion, CSS, variables, and plugins/extensions.
use_cases: unit conversion from the command line
how_to_run: Download the desktop app from the Numi website or the GitHub releases page
Install the terminal version with the shell command given in the README (the command is truncated in the README)
Or install via Homebrew: brew install nikolaeu/numi/numi-cli
Run a calculation: numi-cli "20 inches in cm"
Download the Alfred extension separately; it requires the terminal version
notable: Natural-language input for calculations, currency and unit conversion
Terminal version (numi-cli) usable from scripts and the shell
Homebrew tap for installing the CLI
caveats: Terminal version lacks several desktop features: timezone conversion, CSS, variables, and plugins/extensions
Several features (localization, tokens, dates) are struck through in the README, indicating they were implemented in the terminal version
The Alfred extension requires the terminal version to be installed
